name: Cooling Load from Solar and Occupancy (Parametric)
description: Zone peak cooling load Q_cool = Q_occ + g_solar × A × E_solar is parametrically computed from occupancy heat gain and solar irradiance. Parametric UPR maps occupancy CZ to total cooling load CZ.

elements.name: Occupancy Internal Heat Gain
elements.description: Sensible heat gain from occupants based on attendance uncertainty.

uncertainty.source: ASHRAE 55: peak occupancy 18 persons at 60W/person on hot summer day

elements.name: Maximum Cooling Capacity
elements.description: HVAC plant sizing: maximum available cooling capacity for this zone (W)

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(Q_occ) = F·Q_occ + f; F=1, f=Q_solar=1800 (peak summer solar gain)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: total cooling load is affine function of occupancy gain with fixed solar gain offset.
